description.zh: 用代码做动画视频,零生成费用:知识点讲解、公式推导、代码演示、数据图表。要讲准确的东西(文字、公式、步骤、数字)用它;要真实画面(人物、场景、实拍感)用视频生成模型。讲解视频给内容就能出片;更自由的画面写一段 Remotion 组件代码。需要本机装有 Node.js 18+。Remotion 对个人与 3 人以内的公司免费,更大的公司需要购买 Remotion 公司许可。
description.en: Make animated videos with code, at no generation cost: lesson explainers, formula walk-throughs, code demos, data charts. Use it when accuracy matters (text, formulas, steps, numbers); use a video generation model for realistic footage. Explainers need only content; anything freer is a short Remotion component. Needs Node.js 18+ on this computer. Remotion is free for individuals and companies of up to 3 people; larger companies need a Remotion company license.

help.zh: 可选。留空用官方源;国内网络可以填 https://registry.npmmirror.com。只在第一次准备渲染环境时用到。
help.en: Optional. Leave empty for the official registry. Used only when preparing the rendering environment.

help.zh: 可选。留空时先下载 Remotion 自带的浏览器,下不下来就用本机的 Chrome / Edge;想固定用某一个浏览器时填它的可执行文件路径。
help.en: Optional. When empty, Remotion's own browser is downloaded, falling back to a local Chrome / Edge; set a path to always use one browser.

help.zh: 可选。个人和 3 人以内的公司不需要;更大的公司按 Remotion 许可条款需要购买公司许可,在这里填它的密钥。
help.en: Optional. Not needed for individuals or companies of up to 3 people; larger companies need a Remotion company license and put its key here.

description.zh: 安装 Remotion 与渲染用的浏览器。第一次要几十秒到几分钟,之后几乎是瞬间完成。渲染工具在环境缺失时会自动补,但第一次最好在插件页先跑一下它。
description.en: Install Remotion and the rendering browser. The first run takes from tens of seconds to a few minutes; after that it is near-instant. The render tools fill in anything missing, but run this once from the plugin page first.

description.zh: 给内容,出一段知识点讲解视频(mp4,进素材库):标题 → 一节一节讲(小标题、逐条出现的要点、KaTeX 公式、逐行出现的代码、提示)→ 要点回顾。每段多长按内容算,不用给时间轴。讲数学、物理、编程、概念解释、操作步骤都合适。
description.en: Turn content into a lesson explainer video (mp4, into the asset library): a title, then sections (heading, points that appear one by one, a KaTeX formula, code that appears line by line, a note), then key takeaways. Timing follows the content; no timeline needed. Good for maths, physics, programming, concepts and how-tos.

description.zh: 视频标题,最多 80 字。
description.en: Video title, up to 80 characters.

description.zh: 副标题,一句话说清讲什么。
description.en: Subtitle: one line on what it covers.

description.zh: 标题上方的小标签,如「数学 · 第 3 课」。
description.en: Small tag above the title, e.g. "Maths · Lesson 3".

description.zh: 一节一节讲的内容,1 到 12 节。
description.en: The sections, 1 to 12.

description.zh: 这一节的小标题。
description.en: Section heading.

description.zh: 要点,逐条出现,最多 6 条、每条 140 字以内。
description.en: Points shown one by one, up to 6, 140 characters each.

description.zh: 一条公式,LaTeX 写法(如 a^2 + b^2 = c^2),由 KaTeX 排版。
description.en: One formula in LaTeX (e.g. a^2 + b^2 = c^2), typeset with KaTeX.

description.zh: 一段代码,逐行出现,最多显示 24 行。
description.en: A code snippet shown line by line, up to 24 lines.

description.zh: 一句提示或易错点,放在这一节最后。
description.en: A tip or common pitfall, shown last.

description.zh: 结尾的要点回顾,最多 6 条。
description.en: Key takeaways at the end, up to 6.
Aspect: 16:9 (default), 9:16 or 1:1.

description.zh: 深色(默认)或浅色。
description.en: Dark (default) or light.

description.zh: 强调色,#RRGGBB。
description.en: Accent colour, #RRGGBB.

description.zh: 产出文件名,留空用 explainer.mp4。
description.en: Output file name; explainer.mp4 when empty.

description.zh: 用一段 Remotion 组件代码渲染动画(mp4,进素材库)。代码是一个 TSX 模块,`export default` 一个组件,它收到 `{ data }`(即这里传的 data);用 useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence(都从 'remotion' 导入)做动画。只能 import react、remotion、katex。报错会原样返回,改了再调即可。讲解类内容优先用「讲解视频」。
description.en: Render an animation from a Remotion component (mp4, into the asset library). The code is a TSX module that `export default`s a component receiving `{ data }` (the data given here); animate with useCurrentFrame / useVideoConfig / interpolate / spring / AbsoluteFill / Sequence from 'remotion'. Only react, remotion and katex can be imported. Errors come back verbatim, so fix and call again. Prefer the explainer tool for lesson-style content.

description.zh: TSX 模块源码,export default 一个 React 组件。
description.en: TSX module source that export defaults a React component.
Length, 0.5 to 120 seconds.
Aspect, 16:9 by default (1920×1080).

description.zh: 帧率,默认 30。
description.en: Frame rate, 30 by default.

description.zh: 交给组件的数据(组件从 props.data 读)。
description.en: Data passed to the component (read from props.data).

description.zh: 产出文件名,留空用 animation.mp4。
description.en: Output file name; animation.mp4 when empty.
